name: Volteruno – AI Blog Auto-Publish
author: András Vargyas

sections.description:
Stop bleeding traffic to competitors who blog and you don’t.

Volteruno turns your WordPress site into a sales machine that runs without you. The AI writes ready-to-rank SEO articles, links your WooCommerce products inside every post, adds internal links to your existing pages, and publishes the whole thing automatically — while you focus on actually running your business.

You don’t write a single word. You don’t open Yoast. You don’t hire an agency.
You just see new posts going live, ranking, and sending buyers to your products.

What you actually get

  • AI writes and publishes for you — 3, 10, or 30 posts a month, fully on autopilot.
  • Your WooCommerce products linked inside every article — every blog post becomes a silent salesperson with image, price and a “Buy” button.
  • Internal links to your existing pages — the AI reads your site and weaves in links to your services, categories and key landing pages, so Google sees a real, connected site (not orphan posts).
  • Technical SEO at the level of a senior agency — clean meta title & description, schema-friendly structure, H1/H2 hierarchy, optimized featured image, alt tags, slug, excerpt. Yoast or Rank Math become optional.
  • 25 native languages — Hungarian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Romanian and 18 more, written by AI that actually sounds local. One account, global traffic.
  • Connect in 30 seconds — paste a Connection Code, click Save. No API keys, no FTP, no developer.
  • You stay in control — preview, edit, schedule or unpublish anything. Nothing goes live behind your back.

Why it makes you money

Most WordPress sites have a blog that’s either empty or 3 years old. Google rewards fresh, structured, internally-linked content with product context — exactly what Volteruno produces. Every published article:

  • pulls organic traffic from long-tail searches your competitors ignore,
  • sends that traffic straight to your WooCommerce products via in-article links,
  • signals authority to Google through clean technical SEO and internal linking,
  • keeps working for you 24/7, in 25 languages, without a single extra hour of your time.

Risk-free to try

Free trial on volteruno.com — no credit card. Your first article can be live within 5 minutes of installing this plugin.

How it works (3 steps)

  1. Connect your WordPress site with one Connection Code.
  2. Pick the products and topics you want covered.
  3. Autopilot ON — sit back, posts publish on schedule.

External services

This plugin connects your WordPress site to Volteruno, a third-party SaaS service operated by Volteruno (https://volteruno.com), so AI-written blog posts created in your Volteruno dashboard can be published to your site automatically.

What is sent and when:

  • On connection (only when you click “Save & Connect”): the plugin sends your site URL, the connecting admin’s email/username, the Connection Code you pasted, and a freshly generated WordPress Application Password (named “Volteruno Auto-Publish”) to the Volteruno API endpoint at https://iaifmquygwpugdhrqmpr.supabase.co/functions/v1/wordpress-connect. This is required so Volteruno can authenticate future publishing requests to your site.
  • On publishing (only when you trigger a publish from the Volteruno dashboard): Volteruno sends the post content (title, body, featured image, tags, categories, excerpt, SEO metadata) back to your site via the standard WordPress REST API.
  • WooCommerce product sync (only if WooCommerce is active and only when Volteruno requests it): Volteruno reads your product catalog (titles, descriptions, prices, images, categories, currency) via the plugin’s /wp-json/volteruno/v1/products endpoint, authenticated with your Connection Code. This data is used solely to recommend your own products inside articles generated for your site. No customer data, orders, or personal data are ever read.

No data is sent to Volteruno unless you explicitly install this plugin, paste a Connection Code and click Save & Connect. The plugin does not send any analytics or telemetry.

The Volteruno backend is hosted on Supabase infrastructure, which is why the API endpoint above is on a supabase.co subdomain.

  • Service: Volteruno — https://volteruno.com
  • Terms of Service: https://volteruno.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://volteruno.com/privacy

Privacy

This plugin sends your site URL, the connecting admin’s email/username and an auto-generated WordPress Application Password to the Volteruno API (https://volteruno.com) once, when you click Save & Connect. After that, the Volteruno service uses those credentials to publish articles you create in your Volteruno dashboard. No analytics or tracking data is collected by the plugin itself. See the Volteruno Privacy Policy for full details.
sections.installation:
1. Search “volteruno” in Plugins → Add New and click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Go to Settings → Volteruno in your WordPress admin.
  3. Open your Volteruno dashboard → Integrations and copy the Connection Code for your site.
  4. Paste the code, click Save & Connect. Done — your site is live-linked.
sections.faq:
How much does it cost?

The plugin is free. The Volteruno account that powers it has a free trial (no credit card) and paid plans starting at the price of a few coffees per month — far less than a single freelance article.

Am I really listed as the author?

Yes. Posts are published under your WordPress user, with your name as author. To Google, to your readers, to your customers — it’s your blog. We’re invisible.

What if I don’t like a generated article?

Every article can be previewed and edited before going live. You can schedule, unpublish or delete anything from your normal WordPress admin. Nothing is locked.

Does it really link my WooCommerce products?

Yes — that’s the whole point. The AI reads your product catalog (titles, prices, images) and naturally embeds the most relevant 1–3 products inside each article with image, price and a buy link. Plus it adds internal links to your existing pages and categories.

Will it ruin my SEO?

The opposite. Each article ships with a clean meta title and description, proper H1/H2 structure, optimized slug, alt tags on images, an excerpt, internal links and a featured image. This is the technical SEO setup most agencies charge €500/month for.

Is the connection secure?

Yes. The plugin creates a dedicated WordPress Application Password (named “Volteruno Auto-Publish”) so your real admin password is never shared. One click in Settings → Volteruno → Disconnect revokes it instantly.

Will it touch my existing posts?

Never. The plugin only creates new posts via the official WordPress REST API. It never edits, overwrites or deletes anything you already published.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Volteruno works on any WordPress site. But if you do run WooCommerce, you unlock the in-article product recommendations — and that’s where the real money is.
sections.changelog:
2.2.3

  • Fixed: REST API loopback check no longer shows a false-positive red warning on hosts that block self-loopback requests (cPanel, Cloudflare, strict firewalls). When the connection itself succeeds, the warning is suppressed and falls back to two probe URLs.
  • Fixed: Deactivating the plugin no longer wipes your saved Connection Code. Reactivating restores the connection instantly — no need to paste the code again. Full cleanup still happens on uninstall.
  • Improved: REST API check uses both pretty-permalink and ?rest_route= fallback URLs for higher accuracy.

2.2.2

  • New: Cashvertising-style plugin description and updated WordPress.org banner & icon featuring the official Volteruno brand.
  • Improved: Documentation now clearly highlights in-article WooCommerce product linking, automatic internal linking and senior-grade technical SEO.

2.2.1

  • WooCommerce store integration highlighted: AI now reads your product catalog and recommends products inside every article.
  • Save & Connect UX overhaul: pre-flight environment checks, structured error messages, no more silent page reloads.
  • Added full translations for all 24 official EU languages — the plugin admin UI follows your WordPress site language automatically.
  • Added “Copy diagnostic info” button for faster support.

2.0.3

  • Added “External services” section to readme documenting the Volteruno API connection.
  • Added vargyasandras to the contributors list.

2.0.1

  • First public release on WordPress.org.
  • Full internationalization (i18n) support.
  • Added clean uninstall: removes all plugin options and the Volteruno Application Password on plugin deletion.
